comparison.objective: Place tags at every visible horizon boundary along an opened soil core; candidate removes insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Boundary recognition and repeated marker placement versus recessed coaxial alignment, bimanual hammer impact and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Every horizon boundary must be tagged; no detailed numeric rubric is provided. Candidate requires four verified fractures with complete containment and no damage.
comparison.reason: The record tests perceptual boundary identification and placement, not mechanical fracture or assembly finishing.
